name: Krobu
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

sources.citation: Kraffa, Désiré. 2022. Apprendre le krobou = Learn krobou. Côte d'Ivoire – Ivory Coast. Bilingue français-anglais. Paris: L'Harmattan. 182 pp. ISBN 978-2-343-25451-7.
sources.note: Bilingual phrasebook by a sociologist (publisher's free online extract, text pp. 1-179 downloaded from liseuse.harmattan.fr). Foreword pp. 17-18 says only that the orthography is 'à base phonologique … le krobou s'écrit comme on l'entend'; no chapter on pronunciation, tone or accent; a full-text search for stress/accent/ton(s)/tonal/prosod/intonation/stress gives no linguistic hit. Bibliography pp. 173-175 is ethnographic only.

sources.citation: Kraffa, Désiré. 2021. Guide de conversation français-krobou: Côte d'Ivoire. Paris: L'Harmattan. 117 pp. ISBN 978-2-343-23010-8.
sources.note: Earlier version of the 2022 phrasebook; its 'notes de grammaire de base' could contain a pronunciation note; the publisher's online reader returned no stream URL this time. Very unlikely to state a stress rule.

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en), 'Krobu language', raw wikitext downloaded 2026-09-17 (phonology tables cited to Hérault (ed.) 1983 Atlas des langues kwa de Côte d'Ivoire).
sources.note: Consonant and vowel inventories plus 'Krobu has seven tones; high, mid, low, rising, falling, low-rising, and low-falling' — second-hand from the Atlas chapter; nothing on stress or accent.

sources.citation: Mensah, Emmanuel N.A. 1983. Le Krobou. In Georges Hérault (ed.), Atlas des langues kwa de Côte d'Ivoire, tome 1: Monographies (2e éd.), 425-463. Abidjan: Institut de Linguistique Appliquée / Agence de Coopération Culturelle et Technique.

sources.note: The only descriptive (phonology + morphosyntax) sketch of Krobu; source of the 7-tone inventory quoted on Wikipedia; its 'Phonologie' section is where any statement on accent would be. Harvard holds it in print (Widener Library (offsite storage) PL8424.A85 1983, (a scan can be requested through your own library); HathiTrust uva.x000974809 is search-only.

sources.note: Largest modern work on Krobu by a native-speaker linguist; Ivorian theses of this size normally open with a phonological sketch including tone and a remark on accent; would supersede the 1983 sketch.
